summary: Senior Software Engineer with 18+ years of experience in systems software, C++ development, compiler technologies, desktop applications, and R&D engineering. Experienced in developing LLVM-based JIT software, modernizing legacy C and C++ codebases, designing Windows services and inter-process communication mechanisms, and building reliable cross-platform desktop infrastructure. Strong background in software architecture, performance, reliability, automated testing, and production support. Additional professional experience with Go, compiler construction, and teaching programming-language implementation.

experience.description: Develop and maintain a cross-platform desktop agent and its supporting infrastructure, serving approximately 40–50K weekly active desktop users. Work as part of an engineering team, with end-to-end technical ownership of several critical subsystems.
achievements: Developed and maintained a C++ network-traffic interception and analysis proxy, including browser script injection, root CA certificate management, and traffic filtering.
Took end-to-end technical ownership of the auto-update and recovery infrastructure, Windows service coordination, and installer and release workflows.
Implemented and maintained Windows service and process coordination mechanisms using Windows Services, Named Pipes, Shared Memory, Events, and Mutexes.
Implemented process supervision and crash recovery using a dedicated watchdog process and heartbeat-based health monitoring.
Developed a recovery utility in Go and a lightweight Go command-line client for sending installation and uninstallation events to New Relic.
Contributed to the migration to a unified MSI installer, including integration with updater and recovery components.
Co-designed and implemented an automated functional and behavioral testing framework in collaboration with an SQA engineer and integrated it into the CI/CD pipeline.
Worked on privacy and data-minimization features, controlled update rollouts, feature flags, application-usage events, and performance metrics.
Contributed to the macOS version through cross-platform build and maintenance work, primarily bug fixes and smaller improvements.
Modernized the HTTP client infrastructure, including migration to a coroutine-based implementation and consolidation around libcurl.
Diagnosed and fixed production issues using crash reports and monitoring data from Sentry and Loki.
Worked in a codebase configured for C++23, using modern C++ features as part of the team's development workflow.

experience.description: Developed software and engineering tools for fingerprint-sensor products, security applications, and evaluation workflows.
achievements: Implemented a new version of Accuracy Suite, a matcher-evaluation tool, using C++17.
Designed and implemented CTAP FMA (Fingerprint Management Application) for Windows 7 and macOS using Node.js and Electron.
Developed tools for secure certificate exchange for Microsoft SecureBio and privileged-user account management using C++17, Intel SGX, and OpenSSL.
Adapted the Basic Security solution for resource-constrained platforms using C.
Worked on modernizing fingerprint-sensor Windows driver code from C and C++98 to C++17, including architectural refactoring and improvements to performance and reliability.

experience.description: Worked on compiler infrastructure and simulation tools for a low-level dataflow language.
achievements: Implemented an LLVM-based JIT simulator for a dataflow language in C++.
Optimized and modified LLVM IR passes.
Customized pragma handling in the Clang compiler.
Extended the parser of a low-level dataflow language.

experience.description: Developed, verified, and maintained tools and automation flows for memory compiler technologies.
achievements: Developed, verified, and maintained the MPL tool for MASIS Pattern Language using Tcl.
Extended the ScrambleProcessor library to support the integration of BitBrowser with MASIS using C++.
Implemented a Tcl-based MASIS-versus-GDSII verification flow for address-scrambling verification in SRAM memories.
Modified the Memory Programming Tool (MPT) to support GDSII files containing multiple types of memory cells.
Modified the Verification Pattern Generator (VPG) to support the MASIS format.
Developed and maintained regression tests for MASIC Compiler tools using Bash and Tcl.

experience.description: Developed automation and verification tools for MASIS memory compiler products.
achievements: Designed and implemented MCE, a Qt-based GUI application for group editing memory configuration files.
Performed functional and system verification of MASIS Compiler tools, including MIG, MIV, VIG, VPG, and MPT.
Developed Squish-based GUI test suites.
Developed a MASIS Library script for 65nm memory compilers to provide backward compatibility.
